```{r}
#| label: setup
library(chromr)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

fl <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "example_akta_1.asc",
  package = "chromr"
)

dat <- read_akta_old(fl)
dat
```

The fraction marks give the fraction each point was collected into, and
`chrom_fractions()` gives the volumes each fraction covers.

```{r}
chrom_fractions(dat)
```

```{r}
plt <- dat |>
  mutate(uv = uv - 2050) |>
  ggplot(aes(volume, uv)) +
  geom_area(
    aes(fill = factor(fraction %% 5), group = fraction),
    data = \(d) filter(d, !is.na(fraction))
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 5) +
  theme_bw()

plt
```

## An interactive Plot

```{r}
plotly::ggplotly(plt)
  
```
